name: game-mod-tools
description: 游戏 Mod / 存档工具 monorepo

scripts.build:web: npm run build -w The-Stupendous-World-SaveEdit && npm run build -w The-Stupendous-World-SaveEditPro
scripts.build:save-editors: npm run build --prefix zs2_modkit/app/save-editor && npm run build --prefix nwr_modkit/app/save-editor && npm run build --prefix dq2_modkit/app/save-editor
scripts.build:gui: npm run build --prefix zs2_modkit/app/gui && npm run build --prefix nwr_modkit/app/gui && npm run build --prefix dq2_modkit/app/gui
scripts.build: npm run ui:build && npm run build:web && npm run build:save-editors && npm run build:gui && npm run build:bridge
